defect: The templated VARCHAR CASE (_case_loop<const char *>) copies raw string pointers from res_true/res_false into the result without taking ownership, whereas the replaced SetValue-based Case copied each string into the result's owned_strings, so result strings dangle once the temporary branch vectors in ExpressionExecutor::Visit(CaseExpression) are destroyed.
reason: The fix (after an incomplete MergeHeap attempt in 1c96b90) copies every selected string into result.string_heap via StringCase, repairing the ownership loss that the shallow pointer copy added by this change first introduced; seeing that it dangles requires the caller's temporaries and the removed old Case in vector_operations.cpp.

defect: TransformPrefixExpression applies the PrefixOperator* children in source order, so the leftmost prefix wraps the base expression first and mixed prefixes such as - ~ x become ~(-x) instead of -(~x).
reason: The forward loop over prefix_repeat.children added here survived unchanged until the fix, which only reverses the iteration so the rightmost prefix is applied innermost; the wrong nesting order is readable from the added loop.

defect: The new block-based PartitionFunctor only starts a new partition block when block_counts[idx] == block_capacity after a full TMP_BUF_SIZE flush, but the per-input-block cleanup adds a partial rest to block_counts, so later counts step past block_capacity without ever equalling it (and the cleanup write itself is unchecked), overflowing the pinned partition block.
reason: The fix replaces the equality test with block_count + TMP_BUF_SIZE > block_capacity after both the full flush and the cleanup flush (and drops the multiple-of-TMP_BUF_SIZE assumption); blame shows the equality check and cleanup lines come from this change, and the mismatch is visible within the added function.
